Each badge is a bordered neutral button on the host primary surface (~16px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, full-width on mobile and auto-width from the small breakpoint up) holding a 28-by-28-pixel store glyph (12px end margin, keeping its conventional mark) beside a two-line label — a ~12px caption ("Download on the" / "Get it on") over a ~14px semibold store name ("Mac App Store", "Google Play"). **Feature grid.** A grid that becomes two columns from the small breakpoint up with 32-pixel spacing (stacked with 32-pixel spacing otherwise) of four **feature cards** — each a thin-bordered, host-rounded card on the host primary surface with 16 pixels of padding: a 32-by-32-pixel brand-foreground glyph with 8 pixels beneath it, a ~20px semibold heading-color title with 8 pixels beneath it, and a light-weight muted supporting line (e.g. "Premium Shipping", "Weekly Promotions", "Advanced Filtering", "Secure Payment"). **Design system rule.** Every element here — the heading, the supporting paragraph, the app-store badge buttons (store glyphs and two-line labels), and the feature cards (glyphs, titles, and supporting lines) — must be rendered as an instance of the host design system's predefined component, and all colors, fills, borders, radii, shadows, hover/focus/active states, focus rings, and typography (font family, sizes, weights, letter-spacing) must come from the host design system's tokens. Every button must be the host design system's own button component, with its fills, borders, states, focus rings, and label typography taken only from design-system tokens and never hardcoded; the app-store glyphs keep their conventional marks. Do not hardcode styles and do not introduce any non-design-system, non-agnostic values; the pixel measurements here only fix dimensions, spacing, and layout. **Button padding rule.** The app-store badges use ~16px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, full-width on mobile and auto-width from the small breakpoint up, with a leading 28-by-28-pixel store glyph (12px end margin) and a two-line label. They use the host's bordered neutral button. **Sizing rules.** The container caps hard at 1280 pixels, the app-store glyphs at 28-by-28 pixels, the feature-card glyphs at 32-by-32 pixels, the heading at ~24–36px, the supporting paragraph at ~20px, and the feature-card titles at ~20px. Type, surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, and the brand accent stay agnostic and follow the host design system; padding, gaps, and sizing are fixed in pixels. **Mobile layout rule.** The columns stack the pitch above the feature grid until the large breakpoint; the app-store badges go full-width and stack until the small breakpoint, where they become an auto-width row; the feature grid steps from one to two columns at the small breakpoint.

items.name: Feature Cards With Action Links
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce promotional feature section: a centered heading over a grid of icon feature cards, each ending in an action link. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section so it can drop into any host page. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on a soft secondary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (64 from the medium breakpoint up); content centered in a max-width container of about 1280 pixels with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). **Heading block.** A center-aligned block with 16 pixels beneath it (32 from the medium breakpoint up): a ~24px bold heading-color title with tight tracking and 12 pixels beneath it (~36px from the medium breakpoint up, e.g. "Why [Brand] Shop?") over a ~16px muted subtitle (~20px from the medium breakpoint up). **Feature grid.** A one-column grid that becomes two columns from the small breakpoint up and three from the large breakpoint up with a 16-pixel gap (32 from the xl breakpoint up; 32 pixels above it from the small breakpoint up). Each cell is a **feature card** — a thin-bordered, host-rounded card on the host primary surface with a small shadow, 16 pixels of padding (24 from the small breakpoint up), and center-aligned content: - A centered 48-by-48-pixel muted feature glyph with 16 pixels beneath it. - A ~20px semibold heading-color title with 12 pixels beneath it. - A muted supporting paragraph with 16 pixels beneath it. - An **action link** — a centered row in the brand foreground color, ~18px medium weight, underlining on hover, trailing an 18-by-18-pixel arrow glyph 4 pixels after its label (e.g. "How to make the payments", "Get premium delivery", "Activate your account"). Use about three feature cards. **Design system rule.** Every element here — the heading and subtitle, the feature cards (glyphs, titles, paragraphs, and action links) — must be rendered as an instance of the host design system's predefined component, and all colors, fills, borders, radii, shadows, hover/focus/active states, focus rings, and typography (font family, sizes, weights, letter-spacing) must come from the host design system's tokens. Every link must be the host design system's own link component, with its color, states, focus ring, and label typography taken only from design-system tokens and never hardcoded. Do not hardcode styles and do not introduce any non-design-system, non-agnostic values; the pixel measurements here only fix dimensions, spacing, and layout. **Button padding rule.** The action links are ~18px inline text links trailing an 18-by-18-pixel arrow glyph; there are no box buttons in this section. **Sizing rules.** The container caps hard at 1280 pixels, the feature glyphs at 48-by-48 pixels, the action links at ~18px with 18-by-18-pixel arrows, the heading at ~24–36px, the subtitle at ~16–20px, and the card titles at ~20px. Type, surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, and the brand accent stay agnostic and follow the host design system; padding, gaps, and sizing are fixed in pixels. **Mobile layout rule.** The feature grid steps from one to two to three columns across the small and large breakpoints; each card stays center-aligned with its glyph, title, paragraph, and action link stacked.

items.name: Feature Grid With Testimonial Carousel
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce promotional section pairing a three-column feature grid with a testimonial carousel. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section so it can drop into any host page. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on the host primary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (64 from the medium breakpoint up); content centered in a max-width container of about 1280 pixels with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). **Heading block.** A center-aligned block with 16 pixels beneath it (32 from the medium breakpoint up): a ~24px bold heading-color title with tight tracking and 12 pixels beneath it (~36px from the medium breakpoint up, e.g. "Why us?") over a ~16px muted subtitle (~20px from the medium breakpoint up). **Feature block.** A block with full-width top and bottom borders drawn from the design system's border token, 24 pixels of vertical padding (64 from the small breakpoint up, 32 from the medium breakpoint up), and 16 pixels beneath it (32 from the medium breakpoint up): a one-column grid that becomes three columns from the large breakpoint up with a 64-pixel column gap and 24-pixel row gap (32 from the medium breakpoint up). Each cell is a top-aligned, 16-pixel-gapped flex row of a non-shrinking 36-by-36-pixel muted glyph and a growing, min-width-0 body: - A ~14px semibold uppercase heading-color label with 16 pixels beneath it. - A ~14px muted paragraph with 12 pixels beneath it. - Then either a **link list** — a vertical list of ~14px medium links 12 pixels apart, each a row in the brand foreground color that is underlined and loses its underline on hover, trailing a 20-by-20-pixel arrow glyph 4 pixels after its label (e.g. "Track Your Order", "Schedule Delivery", "Apply Now", "Manage Your Shop") — or a **contact list** — a vertical list of ~14px muted rows 12 pixels apart, each a vertically-centered, 8-pixel-gapped row leading with a 16-by-16-pixel muted glyph (e.g. an office phone line, and a support line whose email is a hover-underline link). Use three feature cells (e.g. "Real time order tracking", "Your marketplace", "Premium support"). **Testimonial carousel.** A sliding carousel about 196 pixels tall (236 from the small breakpoint up, 240 from the large breakpoint up, 200 from the xl breakpoint up) with hidden overflow, holding a set of sliding panels (render about four). Each panel is a one-column grid that becomes two columns from the small breakpoint up and three from the large breakpoint up with a 16-pixel gap, of **testimonial figures**. Each figure is a host-rounded card on a soft secondary surface with 24 pixels of padding: a blockquote of a ~18px semibold heading-color title over a ~14px muted quote paragraph with 16 pixels of vertical margin, and a figcaption — a vertically-centered, 12-pixel-gapped row of a 32-by-32-pixel round **real avatar photo** and a ~16px medium heading-color name. Beneath the carousel, a centered row with 16 pixels above it (24 from the medium breakpoint up) holding previous and next icon-only ghost buttons (the previous with a 16px end margin), each a 28-by-28-pixel arrow glyph in the muted body color shifting to the heading color on hover. **Design system rule.** Every element here — the heading and subtitle, the feature block and its dividers, the feature glyphs, labels, paragraphs, link lists and contact lists (with their arrow and contact glyphs and the email link), and the testimonial carousel (figures, titles, quotes, avatars, names, and the previous/next controls) — must be rendered as an instance of the host design system's predefined component, and all colors, fills, borders, radii, shadows, dividers, hover/focus/active states, focus rings, and typography (font family, sizes, weights, letter-spacing) must come from the host design system's tokens. Every link or button must be the host design system's own link and button components, with their colors, states, focus rings, and label typography taken only from design-system tokens and never hardcoded; the testimonial figures use the host's soft secondary surface token and the avatars are real photographic assets. Do not hardcode styles and do not introduce any non-design-system, non-agnostic values; the pixel measurements here only fix dimensions, spacing, and layout. **Button padding rule.** The link-list and contact-list links are inline text links (the link list trailing a 20-by-20-pixel arrow glyph); the carousel previous/next buttons are icon-only ghost buttons sized to their 28-by-28-pixel glyphs. **Sizing rules.** The container caps hard at 1280 pixels, the feature glyphs at 36-by-36 pixels, the link arrows at 20-by-20 pixels, the contact glyphs at 16-by-16 pixels, the carousel at ~196/236/240/200 pixels tall across the small, large, and xl breakpoints, the avatars at 32-by-32 pixels, the carousel arrows at 28-by-28 pixels, the heading at ~24–36px, the feature labels at ~14px, and the testimonial titles at ~18px. Type, surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, and the brand accent stay agnostic and follow the host design system; padding, gaps, and sizing are fixed in pixels. **Mobile layout rule.** The feature block steps from one to three columns at the large breakpoint (each cell keeping its leading glyph beside the text); each carousel panel steps from one to two to three columns across the small and large breakpoints; the carousel keeps its previous/next controls centered beneath it.

items.name: Centered Description With Showcase And Video
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce "product description" section: a centered, single-column long-form description with a full-width showcase image, intro paragraphs, a key-features bullet list, an embedded product video, closing paragraphs, and a "show more" button. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section so it can drop into any host page. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on the host primary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (64 from the medium breakpoint up); its content is centered in a max-width container of about 1280 pixels with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (dropping to 0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). Inside, a centered ~1024-pixel max-width column holds everything. **Heading.** A ~20px semibold heading-color title ("Product description"), growing to ~24px from the small breakpoint up. **Showcase image.** With 32 pixels of vertical margin (and, from the xl breakpoint up, 48 pixels above / 64 below), a full-width **real product photograph** (a photographic JPG/PNG image, not a line-art SVG illustration) showing the product in context. **Intro copy.** A left-aligned ~672-pixel max-width column (anchored to the start of the section column, not centered) with 24-pixel vertical spacing between blocks: two ~16px normal muted paragraphs of product overview, then a ~16px semibold heading-color label ("Key Features and Benefits:"), then a **feature bullet list** — an outside disc list indented 16 pixels with 16-pixel spacing between items, each item a ~16px normal muted paragraph that begins with a ~16px semibold heading-color lead-in term (e.g. "Brilliant 4.5K Retina display:", "1080p FaceTime HD camera:", "Studio-quality mics for high-quality conversations:", "Six-speaker sound system:", "M1 chip:") followed by its explanatory text. **Product video.** With 24 pixels of vertical margin (48 from the medium breakpoint up), a full-width, host-rounded embedded video player that is 260 pixels tall (540 pixels from the medium breakpoint up). **Closing copy.** A left-aligned ~768-pixel max-width column (anchored to the start of the section column, not centered) with 24-pixel vertical spacing and 24 pixels below it (48 from the medium breakpoint up): two ~16px normal muted paragraphs covering connectivity and condition/warranty notes. **Show more.** A single bordered neutral "Show more..." link styled as a button on the host primary surface with 20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, ~14px medium heading-color text, a neutral hover, and a focus ring. **Design system rule.** Do not hardcode any styling. The heading, paragraphs, feature list, video frame, and show-more button must all be rendered using the host design system's predefined components/tokens (surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, heading/muted text, hover/focus states). Treat the showcase image as a real photographic asset, not an illustration. The pixel values above define only spacing, sizing, and layout rhythm, not colors or chrome.

items.name: Bordered Comparison Grid With Filter Drawer
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce product-listing section: a heading-and-filters toolbar over a single bordered grid of centered product cards (each with a brand eyebrow, title, rating, dual price line, wishlist/compare buttons, and an add-to-cart button) separated by internal divider rules, a "Showing X of Y" prev/next pager, and a hidden filter drawer. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on a soft secondary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (48 from the medium breakpoint up); centered in a ~1280-pixel max-width container with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). **Toolbar.** Identical in structure to variant 1's toolbar — a breadcrumb ("Home" / "Products" / current "Electronics") over a ~20px (→~24px) semibold heading and, on the end, a bordered **Filters button** (opening the drawer described last) and a bordered **Sort button** with its hidden ~160-pixel sort menu. **Comparison grid.** A single host-rounded, bordered, small-shadowed container on the host primary surface whose cells share the design system's divider color; it is one column by default, two from the small breakpoint up, three from the large, and four from the xl, with each cell carrying internal end/bottom border rules so the cells read as a connected table. Each cell is a **product card** — a 24-pixel-spaced, 24-pixel-padded, center-aligned stack: - A 176-pixel-tall image area holding a full-width **real product photograph** wrapped in a link. - A text block: a ~16px medium uppercase brand-foreground eyebrow ("Apple", "Sony", "Microsoft"), a ~20px semibold heading-color title link (underlining on hover), and a centered 8-pixel-top rating row with an 8-pixel gap — five 20-by-20-pixel filled amber stars, a ~14px medium heading-color score ("4.8"), and a ~14px medium muted review-count link ("(2,868)"). - A **price block** bounded by top and bottom border rules with 16 pixels of vertical padding: a ~24px extrabold heading-color price ("$2499") and, 4 pixels below, a ~18px extrabold heading-color secondary price with a normal muted "ex. VAT" suffix ("$2066 ex. VAT"). - A **wishlist/compare row** with a 16-pixel gap: two equal bordered neutral full-width buttons ("Wishlist", "Compare") with 20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, ~14px medium heading-color text, neutral hover, and focus rings. - A brand **add-to-cart button**: full-width, solid brand surface, inverse text, 20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, ~14px medium, leading 20-by-20-pixel cart glyph. Provide eight cards (e.g. iMac 27" $2499/$2066, Apple Watch SE $1399/$1041,94, PlayStation 5 $599/$499, Xbox Series X $499/$399, iPhone 15 Pro Max $1299/$1099, iPad Pro $999/$899, MacBook Pro $3599/$3199, Surface Pro $299/$199). **Pager.** Below the grid, a centered column 16 pixels above (32 from the medium breakpoint up): a ~14px muted help line ("Showing **1** to **8** of **100** Entries", the numbers in medium heading-color spans), then an inline group of two adjoining 40-pixel-tall buttons on a dark/inverse surface with inverse text and ~16px medium labels — a "Prev" button with a leading 20-by-20-pixel arrow (host- rounded on its start) and a "Next" button with a trailing 20-by-20-pixel arrow (host-rounded on its end), joined by a thin divider. **Filter drawer.** A hidden, fixed, full-height, ~384-pixel-max-width left-anchored form on the host primary surface with 16 pixels of padding that slides in: a ~16px semibold uppercase muted "Filters" label, an icon-only close button (20-by-20-pixel X glyph), and a 16-pixel-spaced stack of controls — a 2-column grid of "Product Brand" and "Product Model" selects; a "Manufacture Year" range with two bordered date inputs (each with a leading 20-by-20-pixel calendar glyph) split by a "to" label; a "Price Range" block (two range sliders over a 2-column "From"/"To" number pair); a "Condition" segmented control (All / New / Used); a 2-column grid of "Colour" checkboxes (with round swatches) and a star-based "Rating" radio group; and a "Delivery" 2-column grid of selectable region cards (USA, Europe, Asia, Australia). It ends with a bottom 16-pixel-gap row of a brand "Apply filters" submit button and a bordered neutral "Clear all" button. **Design system rule.** Do not hardcode any styling. The toolbar, connected card grid and its divider rules, eyebrows, ratings, dual price lines, wishlist/compare and add-to-cart buttons, the dark prev/next pager, and the drawer's selects, date inputs, sliders, segmented control, checkboxes/radios, swatches, and selectable cards must all use the host design system's components/tokens (surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, brand/heading/muted text, amber rating stamp, dark/inverse surface, soft brand tint, hover/focus states). Treat every product image as a real photographic asset, not an illustration. Pixel values define only spacing, sizing, and layout rhythm.

items.name: Filter Toolbar With Carousel Product Cards
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce product-listing section: a multi-row filter toolbar panel (with dropdown filters, an info modal, a seller filter, an order-by control, a list/grid view toggle, and an installments alert) over a grid of product cards (each with an image carousel, title, description, installments link, price, color swatches, and wishlist/buy-now buttons), and a pagination control. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on a soft secondary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (48 from the medium breakpoint up); centered in a ~1280-pixel max-width container with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). **Toolbar panel.** A host-rounded, bordered, small-shadowed container on the host primary surface with 16 pixels of padding (24 from the medium breakpoint up) and 16 pixels below it, its rows separated by horizontal divider rules: - **Title row** (16 pixels of bottom padding, ends split from the medium breakpoint up): a ~20px semibold heading-color title with a trailing ~18px medium muted count ("Electronics - Top Products 298 products") and an **info button** — a host-rounded ~14px medium muted row (8px padding, neutral hover) with a leading 16-by-16-pixel info glyph and the text "How the results are ordered" — that opens an **info modal**: a hidden, centered, ~576-pixel-max-width host-rounded panel on the host primary surface with a bordered header (a semibold heading-color title and an X close glyph), a ~14px muted intro paragraph, a disc bullet list of six sort-type explanations (each lead term in medium heading-color: Most Popular, Ascending Price, Descending Price, No. Reviews, Discount%, Newest), and a bordered footer with a brand "I understand" button. - **Dropdown-filters row** (16 pixels of vertical padding, becoming a flex row from the large breakpoint up): on the start, a 16-pixel-gap cluster (2-column grid below the medium breakpoint) of four bordered neutral dropdown buttons — "Brands", "Price", "Rating", and "Shipping to: Americas" — each with a leading 16-by-16-pixel funnel glyph and a trailing 16-by-16-pixel down chevron, each opening a hidden host-rounded panel: Brands (~192px wide, brand checkbox rows each with a trailing count, plus a brand "See all 1,011 results" button), Price (~192px wide, price-range checkbox rows, plus a "See all 100 results" button), Rating (~224px wide, star-row checkbox rows with counts, plus a results button), and Shipping (~288px wide, a stack of selectable region cards plus a results button). On the end, a non-shrinking **Seller** group laid out as a single horizontal, vertically-centered row from the small breakpoint up — a ~16px medium "Seller:" caption on the same line as (not stacked above) a wrapped 12-pixel-gap row of three checkbox options ("Flowbite", "BestBuy", "Amazon"), separated from the caption by a 16-pixel gap. - **Order-by row** (16 pixels of top padding): a row whose ends split from the medium breakpoint up — on the start, a ~16px medium "Order by:" caption and a wrapped 12-pixel-gap row of four radio options ("Newest", "Increasing price", "Decreasing price", "Most popular"); on the end (shown from the medium breakpoint up), a **view toggle** — a bordered host-rounded group with 4 pixels of padding holding two icon-only buttons (a 20-by-20-pixel list glyph and a 20-by-20-pixel grid glyph, neutral hover, each with a tooltip). Beneath the row, a full-width **installments alert** — a host-rounded bar in a soft brand tint with 16 pixels of padding, ~14px brand text, a leading 24-by-24-pixel glyph (shown from the medium breakpoint up), and inline underlined links ("FlowWallet", "how it works"). **Product grid.** A 16-pixel-gap grid: one column by default, two from the small breakpoint up, three from the large. Each cell is a **product card** — a 16-pixel-spaced, 24-pixel-padded, host-rounded panel on the host primary surface with a thin border and small shadow: - A **carousel**: a full-width region with a 16-pixel-bottom, ~288-pixel-tall, host-rounded overflow-clipped frame in which each slide holds a centered, full-height **real product photograph**; one slide is active by default. Beneath it, a centered 16-pixel-gap controls row: a ghost previous button (6 pixels of padding, a 28-by-28-pixel arrow), a ~16px medium muted "1 of 4" counter, and a ghost next button (28-by-28-pixel arrow). - A text block: a ~18px semibold heading-color title link (underlining on hover, e.g. "Apple iMac 27\"") and a ~16px normal muted description 8 pixels below. - An **installments link**: an 8-pixel-gap row of a 16-by-16-pixel glyph and ~14px medium brand-foreground text ("Buy in installments with Flowbite Wallet"), underlining on hover. - A **price-and-swatches row** with split ends and a 16-pixel gap: a ~24px extrabold heading-color price ("$1199") and, on the end, an 8-pixel-gap cluster of round color swatches (each a ~28-pixel circle as a hidden radio with a thin token border, showing a ring when checked). - An **action row** with a 16-pixel gap: a bordered neutral **Wishlist** button (full-width, leading 20-by-20-pixel heart glyph) and a brand **Buy now** button (full-width, solid brand surface, inverse text, leading 20-by-20-pixel cart glyph), both with 20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, ~14px medium, and focus rings. Provide six cards (e.g. iMac 27" $1199, PlayStation 5 Slim $499, iPad Pro $1199, Xbox Series S $499, iPhone 15 Pro Max $1299, iMac 24" $1999) with their own descriptions and swatch sets. **Pagination.** Below the grid, the same centered nav as variant 2: a host-rounded group of 32-pixel-tall ~14px cells with collapsed adjacent borders — a "Previous" cell with a 16-by-16-pixel chevron, numbered page cells ("1", "2", an active "3" in a soft brand tint, "…", "100"), and a "Next" cell with a 16-by-16-pixel chevron. **Design system rule.** Do not hardcode any styling. The toolbar panel and its dividers, dropdown buttons and panels, info button/modal, seller and order-by controls, view toggle, installments alert, product cards, carousels and their controls, installments links, prices, color swatches, wishlist/buy-now buttons, and pagination must all use the host design system's components/tokens (surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, brand/heading/muted text, amber rating stamp, soft brand tint, hover/focus states). Treat every product image as a real photographic asset, not an illustration. Pixel values define only spacing, sizing, and layout rhythm.

items.name: Tabbed Description Reviews Questions Highlights
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce "product information" section: a tabbed interface with four panels — Description (with spec cards), Reviews (summary plus review list), Questions (Q&A accordion), and Highlights (feature cards) — plus a hidden report modal and a hidden write-a-review modal. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on the host primary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding; centered in a ~1280-pixel max-width container with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). **Tab strip.** A centered, ~14px medium muted tab list that gains a bottom border rule from the small breakpoint up; tabs wrap in a row with a 16-pixel horizontal gap. Each tab is a button with a 2-pixel bottom border and 12 pixels of padding; the active tab reads as selected and the rest darken on hover. Tabs, in order: "Description", "Reviews", "Questions", "Highlights". Only the active panel shows. **Description panel.** A grid that is one column by default and, from the large breakpoint up, five columns with a 32-pixel gap, with 16 pixels of vertical padding (32 from the small breakpoint up): - A **main column** spanning three of the five columns, a 24-pixel-spaced stack: two 24-pixel-spaced groups of ~16px muted description paragraphs (some led by a ~16px semibold heading-color term), a hidden duplicate "more info" group, and a **show-more** control — a ~16px medium brand-foreground row with a trailing 16-by-16-pixel chevron that underlines on hover. - A **spec aside** spanning two columns — one column by default (a 2-column grid below the large breakpoint), becoming an 8-pixel-spaced vertical stack from the large breakpoint up. Each **spec card** is a host-rounded panel on a soft secondary surface with a thin border and 16 pixels of padding (24 from the medium breakpoint up): a ~20px semibold heading-color title (e.g. "Display", "Processor", "RAM memory", "Storage") over a divider-separated definition list whose rows each split a ~14px medium heading-color term and a ~14px normal muted value across 8 pixels of vertical padding (e.g. Screen Type / light, Diagonal / 24 inches, Resolution / 4480 x 2520, Format / 4k). **Reviews panel.** A stack: - A **summary card** — a wrapped flex row on the host primary surface with a thin border, small shadow, and 16-to-32-pixel padding/gaps — holding: an **average rating** block (a ~30px bold "5/5", a ~16px muted "Average rating" label, and a row of five 20-by-20-pixel amber stars with a ~14px muted "(3,657 reviews)" count); a thin vertical divider (large screens only); a **clients** block (a ~30px bold "100M+", a ~16px muted "Worldwide Clients" label, and a 16-pixel-gap row of conventional partner brand logos kept as their own marks); another divider; and a **rate-product** block (a ~20px semibold heading-color prompt "Do you own or have you used the product?", a ~16px muted subline, a row of five 24-by-24-pixel muted outline stars with a ~14px medium "Give a note" link, and a brand "Write a customer review" button — solid brand surface, inverse text, 20px/8px padding, ~14px medium — that opens the review modal). - A **list controls row** that splits from the small breakpoint up: a ~14px heading-color "Showing 5,768 Customer Reviews" line (the number in a semibold span) and two **selects** (a review-type select defaulting to "All Reviews" and a time select defaulting to "Recently Added"), each a bordered, soft-input-surface, host-rounded select with ~14px text. - A **review list** — a divider-separated list with a top border rule, each review an article with 24 pixels of vertical padding: a header row with a 40-by-40-pixel host-rounded avatar (a **real photo**) beside a ~14px medium name and a ~14px muted "Total Reviews: N" line (the count in a heading-color span); a ~20px semibold heading-color review title; a row of five 16-by-16-pixel amber stars with a ~14px muted date; one or two ~16px muted body paragraphs; and a footer row with a small bordered neutral "Helpful (N)" button (~12px medium, 8px/6px padding) and, 16 pixels after it, a ~14px medium heading-color "Report" link with a leading 20-by-20-pixel flag glyph that opens the report modal. Provide five reviews. - A **pager**: a centered column with a ~14px muted "Showing 1 to 5 of 53 Customer Reviews" line (numbers in semibold heading-color spans) over two adjoining 32-pixel-tall buttons on a dark/inverse surface with inverse ~14px medium labels ("Previous" host-rounded on its start, "Next" host-rounded on its end). **Questions panel.** With 24 pixels above (32 from the small breakpoint up), a flush accordion of question entries: each **header** a full-width split-ends row with a 12-pixel gap, a bottom border rule, 20 pixels of vertical padding, a left-aligned ~20px semibold heading-color question, and a 20-by-20-pixel chevron; each open **body** a 16-pixel-spaced block with a bottom border rule and 20 pixels of vertical padding holding an author + date row (a ~16px semibold heading-color author and a ~14px muted timestamp), one or more ~16px muted answer paragraphs (some led by a ~16px semibold heading-color term), and a "Was it helpful to you?" row — a ~14px medium muted prompt beside two radio options ("Yes: N", "No: N"). Provide several entries (the first open). Below the accordion, with 24 pixels above (32 from the small breakpoint up), a ~18px muted "Didn't find the answer?" line with a brand underlined "Ask a question" link. **Highlights panel.** With 24 pixels above (32 from the small breakpoint up), a grid with a 16-pixel gap: one column by default, two from the small breakpoint up, three from the large. Each **highlight card** is a host-rounded panel on a soft secondary surface with a thin border and 16 pixels of padding: a ~16px muted eyebrow label (e.g. "Processor Model", "Graphics", "System Memory (RAM)", "Display Type", "Total Storage Capacity", "Screen Resolution"), a ~18px bold heading-color value beneath, a 16-pixel-vertical-margin check list with 4-pixel spacing (each item a row of a 20-by-20-pixel success-color check glyph and a ~16px muted label), and a ~16px medium brand-foreground link that underlines on hover. Provide six cards. **Report modal.** A hidden, fixed, centered, scrollable overlay holding a ~512-pixel-max-width host-rounded panel on the host primary surface with a shadow: a bordered header (a ~18px semibold heading-color "File a report" title and an icon-only close button with a small X glyph) and a form with 16-pixel-gapped fields — an issue-type radio group ("Report listing abuse", "Report a violation"), a "Report reason" text input, a "Describe your issue" textarea (~6 rows), an "Add an attachment" file input, and a terms-agreement checkbox with an inline brand link — over a bordered footer with a brand "Send report" submit button and a bordered neutral "Cancel" button. **Review modal.** A hidden, fixed, centered, scrollable overlay holding a ~672-pixel-max-width host-rounded panel on the host primary surface with a shadow: a bordered header (a ~18px semibold heading-color "Add a review for:" title over a brand product-name link, plus a top-end icon-only close button) and a form with 16-pixel-gapped fields — a star-rating row (five 24-by-24-pixel stars, amber for the chosen rating and muted after, with a ~18px bold "3.0 out of 5" label), a "Review title" text input, a "Review description" textarea (~6 rows) with a ~12px muted "Send a report" hint, a "Add real photos of the product" **dropzone** (a 208-pixel- tall dashed-border soft-secondary upload area with an upload glyph, a "Click to upload or drag and drop" prompt, and a format/size hint), and a terms-agreement checkbox with an inline brand link — over a bordered footer with a brand "Add review" submit button and a bordered neutral "Cancel" button. **Design system rule.** Do not hardcode any styling. The tab strip, description paragraphs and show-more link, spec cards and definition lists, reviews summary (rating, partner logos, rate-product block), list controls and selects, review articles (avatars, ratings, helpful/report controls), dark pager, questions accordion and helpfulness radios, highlight cards and check glyphs, and both modals (inputs, textareas, file/dropzone uploads, checkboxes, buttons) must all use the host design system's components/tokens (surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, brand/heading/muted text, amber rating stamp, success-color stamp, soft secondary and soft input surfaces, dark/inverse surface, hover/focus states). Treat review avatars and any product photos as real photographic assets, and keep partner brand logos as their own conventional marks. Pixel values define only spacing, sizing, and layout rhythm.

items.name: Centered Description With Showcase And Video
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce "product description" section: a centered, single-column long-form description with a full-width showcase image, intro paragraphs, a key-features bullet list, an embedded product video, closing paragraphs, and a "show more" button. Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section so it can drop into any host page. items.name: Gallery Tabs With Configurator
items.promptText: Create a self-contained e-commerce product-overview section pairing an image gallery with thumbnail tabs and a full product configurator (rating, delivery, price, quantity, actions, and option groups for colour, capacity, pickup, and warranty). Do not generate any surrounding site chrome beyond what is described; output only this section so it can drop into any host page. All colors, borders, radii, shadows, and type come from the host design system; the pixel values below define spacing and sizing. **Section frame.** A full-width band on the host primary surface with 32 pixels of vertical padding (64 from the medium breakpoint up); content centered in a max-width container of about 1280 pixels with 16 pixels of horizontal padding (0 from the 2xl breakpoint up). The body is a grid that becomes two columns from the large breakpoint up with a 32-pixel gap. **Gallery column.** A column capped at ~448 pixels (and ~512 pixels from the large breakpoint up) and centered: - A **main image panel** — a host-rounded panel with 16 pixels of padding holding the active **real product photograph** (a photographic JPG/PNG image centered at full width, not a line-art SVG illustration); only the active panel shows. - A **thumbnail tab list** 32 pixels below — a four-column grid with a 16-pixel gap of thumbnail tab buttons; render four. Each thumbnail is an 80-by-80-pixel button (96-by-96 pixels from the medium breakpoint up) with a 2-pixel border, host rounded corners, 8 pixels of padding, hidden overflow, and a centered, fully-contained product photograph; the selected tab carries the design system's border token while the rest stay transparent and reveal the border on hover. **Configurator column.** 24 pixels above it on mobile (removed from the medium breakpoint up): - An **"In stock" status badge** — a small inline pill in the host success palette (a soft success fill with success-strong text), ~10px horizontal / 2px vertical padding, host rounded corners, ~12px medium label, with an 8px end margin. - A **product name** 16 pixels below — a ~20px semibold heading-color title (~24px from the small breakpoint up), allowed to wrap. - A **rating + delivery row** 16 pixels below that becomes a vertically-centered, 16-pixel-gapped row from the xl breakpoint up (stacked otherwise): a **rating cluster** (a 4-pixel-gapped row of five 16-by-16-pixel filled star glyphs in the host rating accent, a ~14px medium muted "(5.0)", and a ~14px medium heading-color underlined "345 Reviews" link that loses its underline on hover) and a **delivery line** (16px above it on mobile, removed from the xl breakpoint up) — a 4-pixel-gapped row of a 20-by-20-pixel location-pin glyph in the brand foreground color and a ~14px medium brand-foreground "Deliver to [Name]- [City] [ZIP]" line. - A **price + mobile-quantity row** 24 pixels below (32 from the small breakpoint up) laid out space-between and vertically centered: a **price** (~24px extrabold heading-color, ~30px from the small breakpoint up) and a **quantity form** shown only on mobile (hidden from the small breakpoint up) — a 8-pixel-gapped row of a "Quantity" cluster (a ~14px medium heading-color label beside a muted info button carrying a 16-by-16-pixel help glyph that opens a small dark tooltip) and a 64-pixel-wide select control (~10px padding) following the **select rule**. - An **actions + desktop-quantity row** 24 pixels below (32 from the small breakpoint up) that becomes a vertically-centered, 16-pixel-gapped row from the small breakpoint up: a **secondary "Add to favorites" button** and a **primary "Add to cart" brand button** (per the button-padding rule, each leading a 20-by-20-pixel glyph with an 8px end margin), plus a **quantity form** shown only from the small breakpoint up (hidden on mobile) identical to the mobile one above. - A **full-width divider** drawn from the design system's border token 24 pixels above it (32 from the small breakpoint up). - An **options grid** 24 pixels below (32 from the small breakpoint up) — a one-column grid that becomes two columns from the small breakpoint up with a 24-pixel gap (32px row gap from the small breakpoint up): - **Colour** — a ~16px medium heading-color label over (8px below) a wrapping, 8-pixel-gapped row of **option chips** (per the chip rule): "Green", "Pink", "Silver", "Blue". - **SSD capacity** — the same label + chip pattern: "256GB", "512GB", "1TB". - **Pickup** (spanning both columns) — a label over (8px below) a column of three **radio options** that becomes a row from the small breakpoint up with a 16-pixel gap; each option is a row of a 16-by-16-pixel radio control beside a text cell (an 8px start margin) with a ~14px medium heading-color label over a ~12px muted helper line (one helper is a brand underlined link); render "Shipping - $19" / "Arrives [date]", "Pickup from [Brand]- $9" / "Pick a [Brand] near you", and a disabled "Pickup from our store" / "Not available" in the muted/disabled tone. - **Add extra warranty** (spanning both columns) — a label over (8px below) a wrapping, 16-pixel-gapped row of three radio options, each a 16-by-16-pixel radio control beside a ~14px medium heading-color label (8px start margin): "1 year - $39", "2 years - $69", "3 years - $99". **Chip rule.** Each option chip is a relative label wrapping a visually-hidden radio input and a selectable box: a centered box with ~8px horizontal / 4px vertical padding, a thin border, host rounded corners, a soft neutral fill, hidden overflow, muted ~14px medium text, and a hover surface; when its input is checked the box takes the host brand-tinted fill, brand border, and brand-foreground text. **Select rule.** The quantity select is the host form-control select: a neutral surface, a thin default border, host rounded corners, ~14px text, ~10px padding, a fixed 64-pixel width, and the host focus ring. **Design system rule.** Every element here — the gallery panel and thumbnail tabs, the "In stock" badge, the product name, the star rating and review link, the delivery line, the price, the quantity form (label, info tooltip, select), the "Add to favorites" and "Add to cart" buttons, the divider, the colour/capacity chips, and the pickup/warranty radios — must be rendered as an instance of the host design system's predefined component, and all colors, fills, borders, radii, shadows, dividers, hover/focus/active states, focus rings, and typography (font family, sizes, weights, letter-spacing) must come from the host design system's tokens. In particular, every form control — the select, radio inputs, and option chips — and every button or link must be the host design system's own form-control, button, and link components, with their fills, borders, states, focus rings, and label typography taken only from design-system tokens and never hardcoded; the status badge uses a semantic success token and the star glyphs may keep their conventional warm/amber color. The gallery images are real photographic assets, never line-art SVG illustrations. Do not hardcode styles and do not introduce any non-design-system, non-agnostic values; the pixel measurements here only fix dimensions, spacing, and layout. **Button padding rule.** The "Add to favorites" (secondary bordered) and "Add to cart" (brand) buttons use ~20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding with ~14px medium labels and a leading 20-by-20-pixel glyph (8px end margin); the info button is icon-only around a 16-by-16-pixel glyph; the select uses ~10px padding. Primaries use the host brand button and secondaries the bordered neutral button. **Sizing rules.** The container caps hard at 1280 pixels, the gallery column at ~448 pixels (~512 from the large breakpoint up), the thumbnails at 80-by-80 pixels (96-by-96 from the medium breakpoint up), the star glyphs at 16-by-16 pixels, the delivery/action glyphs at 20-by-20 pixels, the info/help glyph at 16-by-16 pixels, the radio controls at 16-by-16 pixels, the quantity select at 64 pixels wide, the name at ~20–24px, and the price at ~24–30px. Type, surfaces, borders, radii, shadows, and the brand accent stay agnostic and follow the host design system; padding, gaps, and sizing are fixed in pixels. **Mobile layout rule.** The body stacks the gallery above the configurator until the large breakpoint; the gallery keeps its four-column thumbnail row; the rating/delivery row stacks the delivery line beneath the rating until the xl breakpoint; the quantity form appears inline with the price on mobile and moves beside the actions from the small breakpoint up; the options grid steps from one to two columns at the small breakpoint with the pickup and warranty groups always spanning the full width, and the pickup options stack until the small breakpoint.
